key.name: terminal-argv
key.description: Command used to open a session. Placeholders: {cmd} for the zellij arguments, {cwd} for the working directory, {title} for the window title. Leave empty to use the system default terminal.

key.name: terminal-wm-classes
key.description: Window classes considered terminals when looking for an already open session window. Leave empty to match any window by title.

key.name: pinned-sessions
key.description: Session names pinned to the top of the menu, in display order.
